Palo Alto Networks 

CIS Controls Accreditation 

Palo Alto Networks has been awarded CIS Controls Accreditation , demonstrating the ability to provide CIS Critical Security Controls implementation, auditing, and/or assessment with the assurance that they have met the consistent and rigorous standards of CREST certification. 

Certified Products 

Palo Alto Networks' products have been awarded CIS Security Software Certification for CIS Benchmark(s) as outlined below. 

CIS Benchmark Assessment Certified for Amazon Web Services Foundations 3.0.0, Level 1 Profile 

CIS Benchmark Assessment Certified for Amazon Web Services Foundations 3.0.0, Level 2 Profile 

Prisma Cloud v32.05 

CIS Benchmark Assessment Certified for Google Cloud Platform Foundation v3.0.0, Level 1 Profile 

CIS Benchmark Assessment Certified for Google Cloud Platform Foundation v3.0.0, Level 2 Profile 

CIS Benchmark Assessment Certified for CIS Microsoft Azure Foundations Benchmark v2.1.0, Level 1 and 2 Profiles
